others.route: Work permit (Department of Labour approval, Department of Immigration)

note: Bhutan: foreign workers come in the non-tourist category of workers approved by the Department of Labour (Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment), which vets their qualifications; once it approves, the applicant takes the work permit to the Department of Immigration, with a passport or, for Indian nationals, a voter identity card and the employment entry permit or visa as applicable (Department of Immigration, Non-Tourist categories, 1 June 2023). Indians are asked for the same work permit. Read in archive.org's snapshot of 11 October 2026, since doi.gov.bt doesn't answer this client; the Immigration Services Portal (immi.gov.bt) sends non-tourists to that site. Participants in official cultural events hosted by the government or civil society come on the host agency's approval, a category the form doesn't hold, so no performers' exemption and no days are modelled.

sources.said: Foreign workers approved by Department of Labour and Department of Immigration ... Approval from the Department of Labour (DoL), Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment (MoICE) ... Duly completed Work Permit application form ... Copy of passport or voter identity card with employment Entry Permit/visa as may be ... Once approved, the applicant shall then approach the DoI to process the work permit.
